observed_data: Four dated total-return-series observations from Investboard’s existing global FMP benchmark cache. No new provider API or model call.
holdings_and_policy: Starting notionals, target weights, tolerance band, cash floor, contribution budgets and later sample choice are illustrative user inputs, not market facts or recommendations.
source_currency: EUR listings confirmed against issuer listing information; benchmark schema itself does not store currency.
series_value_warning: These values are stored adjusted total-return series observations. They support modeled sleeve growth over the fixed historical period, not executable market orders, realized tax gains or reconstructed share holdings.

sources.title: iShares Core MSCI World UCITS ETF USD (Acc)

limitations: No provider accuracy certification or live execution quote.
No company-level fund constituents; fund-sleeve weights are not disjoint company exposures. MSCI World already includes German companies.
No forecast, after-cost feasibility pass or investment-performance claim.
No account connection, transaction, recorded outcome or reminder is authorized by these files.
